'''Jerome Flynn''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2000 Minneapolis tournament]] on 22 August 2000 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Joshua Grace's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1158">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-25-minneapolis-minnesota-8-22-00d1158/ minneapolis-minnesota-8-22-00], DeckTech (Joshua "Stormcrow" Grace, 25 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-25-minneapolis-minnesota-8-22-00d1158/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
